name: work_with_indies-deals-mcp
description: Work With Indies (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: The feed answers its whole current list in one response (RSS 2.0, the latest ~100 jobs); query, category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent (the feed documents no parameters) — filter the returned postings client-side and ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). Employment listings at independent game studios: title is '<studio> is hiring a <role> to work from <location>'; the description ends with the tags ('Tags: [Design] [Full Time]').
